"So there was a bunch of us camping and I noticed (we'll call the father) Kevin stumble into his camper so I stumbled in after him. I then ask, 'Kevin is it okay if I spend the rest of my life with your daughter'?

Kevin slowly turns his head towards me and says, 'Which daughter'?"
